notes: Read all 20 source lines before editing. usePageTitle sets the browser document/tab title via the titleStore singleton, which ultimately writes `document.title` — browser-only behavior with no React Native equivalent (no `document`, no window/tab title bar). Per contract rules 4 & 7 the port is a native-safe implementation with an explicit unavailable state (an injectable PageTitleSink defaulting to a no-op), importing only `react` — no DOM/HTML/Recharts/Leaflet/web-UI modules.
L1 `import { useEffect } from 'react'` ported verbatim as `import { useEffect } from 'react';` — the effect that drives the title lifecycle is retained.

L2 `import { getBaseTitle, setBaseTitle } from '@/lib/titleStore'` — the web titleStore module (web/src/lib/titleStore.ts) is itself browser-only (its `apply()` writes `document.title`) and is not yet ported to native (apps/native/src/web-parity/lib has only automationSSE.ts), and the native app defines no `@/` alias (babel.config.js/metro.config.js/jest.config.js have no alias; siblings import via relative paths). To keep this single-file conversion self-contained and gate-passing without preempting titleStore.ts's own future conversion, `getBaseTitle`/`setBaseTitle` are reproduced as module-private functions over a local `baseTitle` singleton seeded to 'TeslaSync' (identical to titleStore.ts's default), and titleStore's browser-only `apply()` (`document.title = prefix + baseTitle`) becomes `applyTitle()` -> an injectable `PageTitleSink` (native analog of the document.title write) that is a no-op until a host calls `setPageTitleSink` — matching the established native seam convention (e.g. useAchievementCelebrationPrefs.ts's `setAchievementCelebrationPrefsStorage`).
L3 blank line preserved (between imports and the doc block) in the ported file's structure.

L4-13 the JSDoc block (purpose: sets the doc title as `"{title} — TeslaSync"`; preserves badge/flash prefixes painted by sibling hooks; writes go through titleStore so the prefix is re-applied on title changes / navigation; cross-reference to web/src/lib/titleStore.ts) is ported and expanded into the file header, additionally documenting the native unavailable-state mapping: native has no document/tab title bar so the OS paint + badge/flash prefix composition are UNAVAILABLE, while the in-memory base-title state + save/restore lifecycle are preserved, and the sink seam is the explicit opt-in.

L14 `export function usePageTitle(title: string) {` ported as `export function usePageTitle(title: string): void {` — identical name + parameter; explicit `: void` return added to satisfy the native TS/eslint config (the function returns nothing, same as the web inferred void).

L16 `const prev = getBaseTitle()` ported verbatim as `const prev = getBaseTitle();` — captures the previous canonical title before overwriting, using the local native-safe getBaseTitle that mirrors titleStore's getter.

L17 `setBaseTitle(`${title} — TeslaSync`)` ported verbatim as `setBaseTitle(`${title} — TeslaSync`);` — same template literal and the exact em-dash (U+2014) `"{title} — TeslaSync"` format; setBaseTitle updates the in-memory base title and calls applyTitle() (sink or documented no-op) in place of titleStore's document.title write.

L18 `return () => { setBaseTitle(prev) }` ported as the cleanup `return () => { setBaseTitle(prev); };` — restores the previous base title on unmount / before the next title change, behavior-identical.

L19 `}, [title])` ported verbatim as `}, [title]);` — same dependency array; the effect re-runs only when `title` changes, so react-hooks/exhaustive-deps is satisfied (getBaseTitle/setBaseTitle are stable module-level functions, not reactive values).

L20 closing `}` of usePageTitle preserved. Added native-only public seams that do not alter the usePageTitle contract: `PageTitleSink` type, `getPageTitle()` reader, and `setPageTitleSink()` injector — the explicit native-safe wiring for the otherwise-unavailable document.title write (rule 7), mirroring the sibling MapOverviewPage.tsx native shim's 'document.title is a native no-op' decision while preserving more of the original logic. Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck; npm run lint -- --quiet; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
